Undesired Pit Stops
Many runners fear that fluids or foods taken during exercise will cause diarrhea.
Diarrhea commonly occurs in novice runners, whose intestinal tracts are not fully
adjusted to the jostling that happens while running. With experience, the problem
tends to abate, but some experienced runners carry toilet paper with them.
If you fear diarrhea attacks, experiment during training with dietary changes to
see if less fiber (such as bran cereals and lots of whole grains, fruits and
vegetables) can reduce the problem. Or try less milk (switch to lactose-free milk
